name: treg-lens-portable-domain
status: TypeScript behavior reference; native Python parity unverified
numericEquality: JSON numbers compare by value; booleans are not numbers. MicroUSD integers are decimal strings. Object key order is irrelevant; array order is significant.

operations.questions.identity: Input text/project; output portable exact-wording id and neutral/branded kind.
operations.questions.lifecycle: Input records/prompts/project and optional edit; output reconciled records, active text list and validity.
operations.scope.build: Input audit and optional records; output frozen scope and validity.
operations.scope.same: Input left/right scopes; output scope-key equality and individual validity.
operations.measurement.run: Input saved run and optional filter; output recorded/requested/answered/missing/coverage/rates/comparability/answerIds.
operations.measurement.trend: Input runs/project and optional filter; output latest/previous ids, UTC daily point ids, excluded run count and nullable delta.
operations.citation.url: Input url/domain; output safe normalized URL or null and owned-domain boundary match.
operations.citation.ownership: Input accepted URL and historical run; output owned/competitor/other/unknown plus optional owner.
operations.citation.analytics: Input runs and optional ownership filter; output deduped answer counts, page/domain evidence projections and independent brand mention/citation counts.
operations.plans.compare: Input plan/runs; output baseline/followup measurement projections, compatibility, nullable delta and explicit unavailable reasons.
operations.plans.followup: Input plan/runs; output original audit input, records, competitor domains and scope or unavailable with reason.
operations.reports.create: Input id/title/project/runs/plans/notes/demo/now; output cleaned frozen report and stable parse round-trip result or valid:false.
operations.reports.immutable: Input previous/next report lists; output whether same-id contents remain immutable (deletion/new-id allowed).
operations.workspace.sanitize: Input full snapshot; output clean snapshot or valid:false; unknown optional records are rejected, unknown object fields are projected away.
operations.money.convert: Input reportedUsd, optional knownSubtotalUsd and costKnown; output decimal-preserving signed-int64 microUSD strings and nullable final total or valid:false.
operations.continuity.project: Input complete saved workspace; output ordered step IDs/actions, recent record IDs/original timestamps/actions and current-brand dismissal count. English UI copy is excluded.

additionsAfterReferenceRevision: Portable decimal-to-microUSD normalization; does not change app billing
Optional continuity preferences and evidence-derived guidance from this preparing-for-native release
